description: On a writable copy of the qd fixture, QueryDef.OpenRecordset(dbOpenSnapshot) is called on the saved update QUpd, delete QDel, append QApp, make-table QMake and DDL QDdl, with DBEngine.Errors after each. Afterwards the rows of T and W are read and TableDefs (after Refresh) are listed, to show whether any of the calls had an effect.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
